nodes.text: @wcdispatch Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is what stealth was referring to. it has been around circa 2001.  It is a RNA virus much symptomatic similarities to RSV. I had it back in 2015. Typical flu type symptoms, I have Cystic Fibrosis and hit me pretty hard.
